title: [review] messaging.py:137: self._next_id never updated af
description: In render_post, candidate_next_id is computed (lines 130-137) but never written back to self._next_id. All messages posted without an explicit 'id' will receive id=1, causing collisions. Subsequent messages overwrite self._sent['1'] and self._sent_order never grows beyond one entry. Fix: add 'self._next_id = candidate_next_id' before returning the CREATED response (before line 150).
close_reason: Fixed: Added self._next_id = candidate_next_id before return in render_post (line 150) to persist the computed next ID. Verified with integration test showing proper ID sequence (1, 2, ...) and explicit ID handling.
